semantic_atoms.claim: At historical Project-Frankenstein commit 39c5423e0bfae54b971aab0be82f225f7a5890b8, services/project_engine.py defines persistent project policy state and a check_policy(project_id, action) decision method.
The same pinned source contains direct Bash/Python tool execution through subprocess.run() in the project tool path.

Within the same pinned services/project_engine.py source, source-local call-trace inspection found the definition of check_policy() but no invocation of check_policy() on the direct tool-execution path. Therefore policy method/schema presence is not source evidence that each project tool effect is policy-gated.
semantic_atoms.scope_note: This negative result is bounded to the pinned file/source-local call graph. It does not prove that no external wrapper, hook, caller or host process enforced policy elsewhere.

semantic_atoms.claim: An external caller, wrapper, hook or host-side enforcement layer may have called policy checks before reaching the direct project_engine tool path.
semantic_atoms.falsifier_or_discriminator: Trace repository-wide callers and pinned historical entrypoints at the same source epoch; promote only if an exact call edge or runtime receipt binds policy decision to the concrete tool invocation.

contradictions.resolution_rule: Do not describe policy storage or a policy-check method as effect enforcement unless an exact invocation edge or runtime receipt binds the policy result to the concrete effect. failure_atlas_proposal.engineering_rule: METHOD_PRESENT != ENFORCEMENT_PRESENT. Acceptance must prove every real effect path traverses the canonical blocker and that deny/unknown states prevent execution rather than merely log classification.
